intents.title: Readiness decision closure and blocker governance

outcome.summary: All policy and dependency blockers that could halt build execution are resolved or explicitly accepted with owners.

intents.build_target:
- Create a readiness tracker for unresolved architecture and policy blockers
- Assign owner, target decision date, and impact path for each blocker
- Enforce phase-entry rule that no hard blocker remains without an accepted assumption
guardrails: Must not allow implementation phases to start with unresolved hard blockers.
Must not close blockers without named accountable owners.
out_of_scope: Must not implement end-user features in this intent.
intents.acceptance: A delivery lead can review the readiness tracker and confirm all hard blockers are either resolved or explicitly accepted with owner and date.

intents.title: Patient account registration and profile gate

outcome.summary: Patients can create an account, verify identity, and reach a complete profile before starting subsidy requests.

intents.build_target:
- Create Experience Cloud registration and login flow with email and password
- Capture required onboarding fields: language, insurance details, and contact profile
- Enforce profile-complete gate before subsidy application entry point is visible
- Persist onboarding completion status for downstream lifecycle automation
guardrails: Must not enable social sign-in in this phase.
Must not expose subsidy request forms before onboarding completion.
Must not store unrestricted clinical notes in onboarding fields.
out_of_scope: Must not migrate legacy patient records in this intent (handled by INT-008).
Must not implement multilingual content governance workflow (handled in later operations).
intents.acceptance: A patient creates a new account, completes onboarding fields, and only then sees the subsidy application start action; an incomplete profile keeps that action hidden.

open_questions.question: Which exact fields are mandatory at onboarding versus deferred to first application?

intents.title: Identity policy baseline and access controls

outcome.summary: Internal and external access model is consistent with launch policy and ready for downstream role-based work.

intents.build_target:
- Define baseline permission sets for patient users and internal assessor users
- Configure access boundaries so internal users cannot view raw medical-history content
- Capture launch policy markers in metadata for deferred social sign-in decision
guardrails: Must not deploy direct production access changes without explicit confirmation.
Must not grant internal users unrestricted patient clinical visibility.
out_of_scope: Must not implement AD federation topology in this intent (handled by INT-008).
intents.acceptance: An assessor can view eligibility evidence status but cannot open sensitive medical-history payload details.

open_questions.question: Is social sign-in still deferred after Phase 1 go-live preparation?

intents.title: Subsidy application orchestration and state machine

outcome.summary: Applications move through a consistent, auditable lifecycle across regions.

intents.build_target:
- Create subsidy application object model and lifecycle statuses
- Implement submission, review, pending-verification, approved, rejected, and closed transitions
- Apply regional state standardization and timestamped audit trail for each transition
- Surface current lifecycle state to patients and internal assessors
guardrails: Must not allow untracked status changes outside the lifecycle engine.
Must not bypass required verification checks before approval.
out_of_scope: Must not add practitioner assignment rules in this intent (handled by INT-005).
intents.acceptance: An application submitted by a patient moves from Submitted to Pending Verification to Approved or Rejected with a visible and auditable history for each transition.

intents.title: Eligibility checker integration with resilient fallback

outcome.summary: Eligibility checks are automated when available and safely recover when the external checker is slow or unavailable.

intents.build_target:
- Integrate subsidy application flow with health insurance eligibility checker endpoint
- Handle slow response path with pending status and asynchronous retry
- Route unresolved checks to manual assessor queue with reason codes
- Record checker response outcome for compliance and reporting
guardrails: Must not auto-reject when checker response is missing or timed out.
Must not expose raw external payload fields directly to end users.
out_of_scope: Must not redesign third-party checker SLA commitments (external owner).
intents.acceptance: A delayed checker response places the application in Pending Verification and later resumes automatically, while assessors can manually intervene when retries fail.

external.need: Stable endpoint, auth credentials, and timeout/retry guidance

intents.title: Practitioner assignment and reassignment engine

outcome.summary: Eligible applications are assigned to the right practitioner quickly, with deterministic reassignment and escalation rules.

intents.build_target:
- Implement assignment logic by treatment type and proximity input
- Start practitioner acceptance SLA timer at assignment
- Reassign on decline or timeout using ordered fallback rules
- Escalate overdue cases to managers and track escalation outcomes
guardrails: Must not create infinite reassignment loops.
Must not assign outside policy-eligible practitioner pools.
out_of_scope: Must not implement full geospatial optimization engine in this intent (external service may be required).
intents.acceptance: A new eligible application is assigned, reassigned when declined, and escalated to a manager when SLA limits are breached.

open_questions.question: What is the definitive geospatial matching method and tie-break order?

intents.title: Assessor collaboration and support routing

outcome.summary: Assessors can manage inbound collaboration requests with consistent routing and traceable handoffs.

intents.build_target:
- Configure collaboration intake channel to create or update trackable work records
- Route conversations to assessor queues based on language, region, and request type
- Provide escalation actions and status visibility inside assessor workspace
- Capture transcript and disposition metadata for quality and governance
guardrails: Must not allow collaboration records to bypass case/application traceability.
Must not expose restricted medical-history content in support channels.
out_of_scope: Must not commit to 24x7 staffing model in platform configuration (operating model decision).
intents.acceptance: A patient support interaction is routed to the right assessor queue, linked to the underlying application record, and escalated through manager workflow when thresholds are exceeded.

intents.title: Operational reporting and escalation visibility

outcome.summary: Leads can monitor queue health, SLA performance, and escalation load by region.

intents.build_target:
- Build dashboards for application lifecycle throughput, pending verification backlog, and overdue assessments
- Add manager-facing escalation report with aging and ownership views
- Include regional slices for APAC, EMEA, and AMER operations
guardrails: Must not expose personally sensitive fields in manager summary reports.
out_of_scope: Must not deliver predictive analytics in this phase.
intents.acceptance: An operations manager can open a dashboard and identify overdue assessments, current escalation owners, and regional queue pressure in one view.

intents.title: Migration cutover and security hardening

outcome.summary: Cutover from legacy processing is controlled, reconciled, and secure for steady-state operations.

intents.build_target:
- Execute final migration load for in-scope patients, applications, and assessments
- Reconcile migrated records and flag exceptions for manual remediation
- Enforce final access controls and revocation rules for practitioner time-bound visibility
- Run hypercare triage workflow for high-priority defects
guardrails: Must not migrate records without reconciliation checkpoints.
Must not leave temporary elevated access permissions active after cutover.
out_of_scope: Must not redesign upstream legacy-system data quality processes.
intents.acceptance: Cutover completes with reconciled record counts, unresolved exceptions tracked, and security controls validated before business-as-usual handoff.

external.need: Final export and in-flight application freeze window
